title: Telemetry Relay Marshaller for Canonical Correlation and Polyglot Sinks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a lightweight, asynchronous telemetry relay (marshaller) that canonicalizes correlation identifiers, normalizes structured log shapes, applies tenant-safe ID translation, and forwards to multiple storage/analysis backends (Loki and ELK variants) via format adapters. The relay lives in the edge tier before the main ingestion fabric and is designed to reduce downstream schema churn, provide predictable backpressure to clients, and centralize correlation/trace repair logic for heterogeneous producers.
acceptance_criteria: Relay accepts HTTP/gRPC telemetry from services and normalizes incoming correlation headers (traceparent, x-request-id, x-correlation-id) into a canonical internal header 'rdw-cid'
Relay applies tenant-safe translation: original tenant IDs are replaced with reversible pseudonyms when configured by customer, and a mapping audit is logged to an encrypted KMS-backed store
Relay exposes an adapter interface; two adapters implemented and tested: Loki line-protocol adapter and Elastic-compatible bulk JSON adapter
Relay supports per-tenant rate limits and emits backpressure signals (HTTP 429 + Retry-After and gRPC RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) when downstream queues exceed thresholds
End-to-end tests show no more than 5% additional p95 latency for telemetry producers under normal load and graceful degradation under overload
Documentation and SDK snippets for Node/Python demonstrating correlation header propagation and optional sampling
Operational dashboards (ingress rate, adapter queue depth, translation error-rate) added to Console observability with alerts for adapter lag > 60s
tasks: Design canonical correlation header schema and mapping rules (contribute to confluence doc)
Implement relay core: HTTP/gRPC fronting, canonicalization, tenant translation module
Build adapter interface + Loki adapter (push to loki/api/loki/push style) and Elastic adapter (bulk endpoint batching)
Integrate backpressure & queueing: token-bucket + high-water marks + retry metadata propagation
Add feature flags for tenant-translation and sampling for gradual rollout
Write E2E tests that validate correlation repair across service restarts and adapter failover
Create Console dashboards and alerts; add cost/ingest metrics to existing billing pipeline
comments: 2025-02-18: Spike completed — prototype normalizes traceparent and x-request-id into rdw-cid. Observed ~3% p95 delta in synthetic traffic.
2025-02-25: Decided to keep tenant-translation reversible using envelope keys to satisfy audit requirements; will use KMS-wrapped keys per-tenant.
2025-03-03: Arjun: started adapter interface PR. Chose simple per-adapter async worker model to allow independent backpressure and retry semantics.
2025-03-06: Security review note — need to document key rotation and ensure mapping logs are encrypted-at-rest. Security owner assigned follow-up (SEC-121).
2025-03-10: QA discovered a race when toggling sampling flag; added a short-term kill-switch on config to avoid duplicated forwarding. Follow-up task created.
notes: This relay is intended to reduce the number of schema adapters downstream and make rollouts to multiple backends less error-prone. Keep payload transformations minimal and reversible where customers opt into tenant translation.
